title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday for November 2026 — Snort rules and prominent vulnerabilities
summary: Microsoft has released its monthly security update for November 2026, which includes 1328 vulnerabilities affecting a range of products, including 60 that Microsoft marked as "critical." Out of 60 "critical" vulnerabilities, 45 are remote code execution (RCE) vulnerabilities.

title: Microsoft Fixes Nearly 1,100 Security Vulnerabilities
summary: Microsoft did another four-digit patch drop today, releasing updates to fix almost 1,100 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software. This month's Patch Tuesday addresses 63 critical flaws -- including a zero-day in Microsoft Outlook -- and comes amid important security updates from other software makers, including Adobe, Apple, Google and Mozilla.

title: [CVSS 8.2 HIGH] CVE-2026-120977 — On affected platforms running Arista EOS with 802.1X with Dynamic Host Configura…
summary: On affected platforms running Arista EOS with 802.1X with Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) device profiling enabled, a network-adjacent attacker can send a crafted DHCP packet to force the device to record a spoofed device profile. This may potentially allow the authenticated supplicant to acquire unauthorized access to a network segment with elevated privileges.

title: [CVSS 8.8 HIGH] CVE-2026-102166 — Arista C-260 and C-250 access points ship with fleet-wide static cryptographic k…
summary: Arista C-260 and C-250 access points ship with fleet-wide static cryptographic keys used for firmware image verification and SSLP authentication. An attacker who is able to access these keys would be able to create modified firmware that will pass verification checks. This vulnerability is specific to the C-260 and C-250 models; other access point models enforce digitally signed upgrade images with secure boot and are not affected by this issue.

title: [CVSS 8.8 HIGH] CVE-2026-95960 — Access of resource using incompatible type ('type confusion') in Windows Advance…
summary: Access of resource using incompatible type ('type confusion') in Windows Advanced Rasterization Platform allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

title: [CVSS 9.8 CRITICAL] CVE-2026-85844 — Authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel in Windows Kerberos all…
summary: Authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel in Windows Kerberos allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

title: [CVSS 9.0 CRITICAL] CVE-2026-80095 — Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripti…
summary: Improper neutralization of input during web page generation ('cross-site scripting') in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

title: [CVSS 8.8 HIGH] CVE-2026-126087 — Untrusted search path in the cross-user process launcher in Open Job Description…
summary:
Untrusted search path in the cross-user process launcher in Open Job Description (OpenJD) Sessions for Python before 0.11.0, as used in the AWS Deadline Cloud worker agent before 0.33.0, on Linux might allow an authenticated remote user with permission to submit jobs to a queue to execute arbitrary code as the worker agent OS user and obtain the AWS credentials held by the worker agent via a crafted job that modifies the PATH environment variable.



To remediate this issue, users of customer-managed fleets should upgrade the Deadline Cloud worker agent to version 0.33.0 or later, which includes OpenJD Sessions 0.11.0. Service-managed fleets were remediated service-side.

Barracuda Networks Email Security Gateway (ESG), Load Balancer, Application Delivery Controller (ADC), Message Archiver (BMA), WAF Control Center (WCC), Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Web Security Gateway (WSG) contain an OS command injection vulnerability. This vulnerability could allow an authenticated administrator to inject OS commands that execute with root privileges when the crafted timezone value is subsequently processed. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-116606
Required: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
Due: 2026-11-13

title: The Race Against the 3-Day Clock: How Rapid7 Helps Meet BOD 26-04 Compliance

Strip away the regulatory language and it reads like a single operational fact: for a vulnerability that is actively exploited, publicly reachable, and grants an attacker full control, you now have three calendar days to remediate it — and you must run a forensic investigation in parallel to determine whether you've already been breached.The 2026 Verizon Data Breach Investigations Report puts the industry's median full-remediation time at 43 days, adding ...

title: The Classics Return: Vulnerable E-Mail Scripts, (Wed, Nov 4th)
summary: One of the early web application vulnerabilities I remember was CVE-2000-0411 [CVE]. This was a simple vulnerability in a CGI-bin script used to send e-mail. The vulnerability was pretty straightforward: Adding additional parameters to the URL leaked environment variables. Other vulnerabilities allowed setting the "To" address and were heavily abused by spammers. And if parameters were passed directly to the sendmail binary, similar vulnerabilities could allow arbitrary code execution.
title_ja: クラシックが帰還：脆弱なメールスクリプト、(水曜日、11月4日)
summary_ja: 私が覚えている早期のウェブアプリケーションの脆弱性の一つにCVE-2000-0411 [CVE]があります。これは、メールを送信するCGI-binスクリプトにおけるシンプルな脆弱性でした。この脆弱性は非常にシンプルで、URLに追加のパラメータを指定することで環境変数が漏洩されました。他の脆弱性では「To」アドレスを設定でき、スパマーによって大きく悪用されました。また、パラメータを直接sendmailバイナリに渡す場合も、類似の問題が発生しました。

User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.8. The following CVEs are assigned: CVE-2026-121742.

title: [KEV] CVE-2024-27834 — Apple Multiple Products: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
summary:
Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.
Required: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
Due: 2026-11-18
